newsitem.title: EU: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, FEB 24 - SUNDAY, MAR 2.
newsitem.headline: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, FEB 24 - SUNDAY, MAR 2.

text.p: BRUSSELS - EU foreign ministers meet (Monday-Tuesday); discussions focus on Mediterranean policy, Cyprus, South Africa, trapping standards; 10th inter-governmental conference meets on the margin of the Council (Monday); Association Council meetings with Bulgaria, the Slovak Republic and Cyprus (Tuesday).

BRUSSELS - Palestinian President Yasser Arafat signs EU-Palestinian Authority interim association accord with EU - followed by a news conference; meets European Commission President Santer and Commissioner Marin (Monday).
BRUSSELS - Dutch Housing and Environment Minister Margreet de Boer holds news conference on the EU Dutch presidency working programme (Tuesday).

BRUSSELS - EU-San Jose meeting involving Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama (Tuesday-Wednesday); main discussions focus on external Generalised System of Preferences privileges; industrial cooperation and political matters; closing news conference on Wednesday.
BRUSSELS - European Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro and World Bank Vice President Sarbib hold joint news conference (Tuesday).
BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (Wednesday).
BRUSSELS - European Commissioner Cresson and Societe General de Belgique President Etienne Davignon hold joint news conference on the fourth research framework programme (Wednesday).
AMSTERDAM - EU-Canada ministerial meeting; European Commissioner Brittan attends (Wednesday).
BRUSSELS - Dutch Health Minister Els Borst holds news conference on the Dutch EU presidency programme (Wednesday).

BRUSSELS - Economic and Social Committee holds plenary session (Wednesday-Thursday); European Commission President Santer and ECOSOC President Tom Jenkins hold joint news conference on "Confidence pact for employment: perspectives after Dublin" (Thursday).
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - General Affairs Council (0930/0830 GMT) (and Tuesday).
- Preparation and organisation of the 2nd Ministerial meeting of the Euro-Mediterranean Partnership (follow-up to Barcelona);
- Egypt: state of negotiations on an association agreement;
- Lebanon: state of negotiations on an association agreement;
- Jordan: state of negotiations on an association agreement.
- Preparation for Association Council and joint ministerial meeting with Cyprus.
- State of trade negotiations with South Africa.
- Mid term revision of Council decision 91/482/EEC on the association with overseas territories and the Community.
- Follow-up to the information mission in Belarus.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - On the margins of the Council, exchange of views with EP President Jose Maria Gil Robles, MEPs Elisabeth Guigou and Elmar Brok followed by the 10th inter-governmental conference (IGC) meeting (1530/1430 GMT).

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - On the margins of the Council, Palestinian President Yasser Arafat signs EU-Palestinian Authority interim association accord (1230/1130 GMT) - followed by a news conference; meets European Commission President Santer and Commissioner Marin at 1500/1400 GMT at the Justus Lipsius building; attends working dinner hosted by the Dutch EU presidency with EU foreign ministers.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
Affairs Secretary of State Anneke Van Dok

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Alliance with Indigenous Peoples holds news conference (1100/1000 GMT). Northern Quebec Eskimo Leader Zebedee Nungak gives address on the Inuit position that their territory should remain part of Quebec in the event of Quebec separation. Venue: International Press Centre (IPC). Contact: Wendel Trio, European Alliance with Indigenous Peoples (322) 733 3653.

BRUSSELS - British Chamber of Commerce hosts debate on "Third party rights in EU competition cases: a balanced procedure or an abuse of process?" (1730/1630). Venue: Le Meridien. Contact: British Chamber of Commerce (322) 540 9030.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - General Affairs Council (second of two days).
- (1100/1000 GMT) Association Council with Slovak Republic.

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Dutch Housing and Environment Minister Margreet de Boer holds news conference on the EU Dutch presidency working programme; climate problem and the dialogue on the environment with Central and Eastern European countries (1100/1000 GMT). Venue: Justus Lipsius building.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner de Deus Pinheiro and World Bank Vice President Sarbib hold joint news conference (1215/1115 GMT).

LUXEMBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Commission hosts news conference on the occasion of the "Eurobus" launch (1000/0900 GMT). Venue: Eurobus, place d'Armes. Contact: European Commission representation (352) 4301 32925.

THE HAGUE (NEW ITEM) - EU-San Jose meeting involving Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama (0900/0800 GMT) (and Wednesday). Main discussions focus on external Generalised System of Preferences (GSP) privileges, industrial cooperation and political matters.
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
Women's Rights - holds public hearing on
taxation system in the EU, VAT and public
Jan Pronk and Commissioner Bonino attend;

PARIS (NEW ITEM) - EP President Jose Marie Gil Robles on official visit (and Wednesday); meets French President Jacques Chirac, Prime Minister Alain Juppe and General Assembly President Philippe Seguin. Main discussions focus on the final phase of negotiations of the inter-governmental conference (IGC).

BRUSSELS - Union of Industrial and Employers' Confederations of Europe (UNICE) holds press breakfast (0815/0715 GMT). UNICE Chairman Francois Perigot will brief on UNICE's view on the inter-governmental conference (IGC); Commission initatives on the completion of the single market; Commission communication on the social dialogue. Venue: Royal Windsor Hotel. Contact: Alistair MacIntyre, UNICE (322) 237 6562.

BRUSSELS - The Euro-Arab Centre for Studies holds conference on "Euro-Arab relations: present and future" (0900/0800 GMT) (to Thursday). Sessions include: the Euro-Arab dialogue; Euro-Arab political relations; relations and security; economic relations; commercial and financial relations; cultural relations; the Euro-Islamic dialogue; the European and Arab regional groups. Speakers include: European Commissioner Marin; UNESCO Director General Federico Mayor and Arab League States Secretary General Ahmad Ismat Abdel Meguid. Contact: The Euro-Arab Centre for Studies (33) 1 49 53 95 80.
BRUSSELS (EXPANDED ITEM) - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting.
- Commissioner Bjerregaard communication establishing a joint action in water policy.
- Commissioner Fischler communication fixing farm product prices for 1997-1998.
- Commissioner Wulf-Mathies communication on objective 2 for United Kingdom, Belgium, the Netherlands and Denmark.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Cresson and Societe Generale de Belgique President Etienne Davignon hold joint news conference on the fourth research framework programme (1245/1145 GMT).

THE HAGUE (EXPANDED ITEM) - EU-San Jose meeting involving Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua, Panama (0830/0730 GMT) (second of two days). Closing news conference on the outcome of the meeting at 1145/1045 GMT.
AMSTERDAM (NEW ITEM) - EU-Canada ministerial meeting; European Commissioner Brittan attends.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Dutch Health Minister Els Borst holds news conference on the Dutch EU presidency programme (1700/1600 GMT). Venue: Justus Lipsius building.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
BRUSSELS - Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) holds plenary session (and Thursday).
- Employment, competitiveness and internationalisation of the economy.
- Modification of decisions on the Socrates programme - Youth for Europe - Leonardo, including Turkey.
- Fixing of veterinary medicine residue limits in foodstuffs of animal origin.
- Approximation of legislation on limit of marketing of certain hazardous substances and preparations.
- Role, status and responsibility of the EU account auditors (green paper).
- Conditions required for vessels transporting hazardous or polluting merchandise.
- Promotion of sustainable and efficient mobility.
- Green paper "education-training-research: obstacle to trans-national mobility".
- Burden of proof in the event of sex discrimination.
- Inventing tomorrow - European research at the service of citizens.
- Management regime efforts in fisheries in the Baltic Sea.
- Bonus grant for definitive abandonment of wine areas.
- Use and trade of enzymes, micro-organisms in animal use.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds lunchtime meeting on "Finland's first two years of EU membership" (1315/1215 GMT). Speaker is Finland Permanent EU Representative Antti Satuli. Venue: CEPS. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911. Reuter EC Report Weekly Diary (page 3/3 - Thursday-Sunday)
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Papoutsis holds news conference on the final report of the bankers and SMEs round table.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer and Commissioner Marin meet Arab League General Secretary Abdel Meguid.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
- (0900/0800 GMT) Foreign Affairs - High Representative for
BRUSSELS - Economic and Social Committee (ECOSOC) holds plenary session (second of two days).

European Commission President Santer and ECOSOC President Tom Jenkins hold joint news conference on "Confidence pact for employment: perspectives after Dublin" (1030/0930 GMT). Venue: ECOSOC. Contact: ECOSOC (322) 546 9393.

BRUSSELS - European Quality Beef holds news conference (1100/1000 GMT). Main issues discussed: nutritional aspects and consumer issues; Community policy in the promotion of agricultural products. Venue: International Press Centre (IPC). Contact: Francine Robbens (322) 218 7241.

BRUSSELS - Cogen Europe holds conference on "Energy market liberalisation - What impact on the environment" (1430/1330 GMT). Speakers include: MEPs Ken Collins and W.G van Velzen. Venue: Renaissance Hotel. Contact: Cogen Europe (322) 772 8290.
AMSTERDAM - Informal Development Council (to Sunday). No agenda yet available.

COLOGNE, Germany - ARD Westdeutscher Rundfunk hosts conference on the "Information society in Europe" (1000/0900 GMT). Speakers include: European Commissioner Bangemann and German Education, Science, Research Minister Juergen Ruettgers. Venue: WDR, Funkhaus Wallrafplatz. Contact: Stephan Piltz, WDR (49) 221 220 2405.
AMSTERDAM - Informal Education Council. No agenda yet available.
